retrieved_chunks.text: In RESTful HTTP architectures, a method is safe if it does not modify server resource state (such as GET and HEAD). A method is idempotent if executing identical requests multiple times yields the same server state as executing it once. GET, PUT, and DELETE are idempotent by specification, whereas POST is neither safe nor idempotent because repeated requests may create duplicate resources.
